001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.path.XPath;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.io.OutputStream;
008import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
009import java.io.StringWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.logging.Logger;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
020import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
021
022/**
023 * XML Filter Command Class
024 *
025 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from XML using XPath expressions. Unlike
026 * XmlNavigateCommand which applies transformations, XmlFilterCommand only extracts/filters elements
027 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
028 *
029 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using XPath expressions - Preserve exact XML structure
030 * of extracted elements - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for complex path
031 * expressions including nested elements and attributes
032 */
033public class XmlFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
034  private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(XmlFilterCommand.class.getName());
035
036  private final XPath xpath;
037
038  // Deprecated fields for backward compatibility
039  @Deprecated private final String legacyXpath;
040
041  /**
042   * Constructor for XML filtering with XPath selector.
043   *
044   * @param xpath the XPath expression to extract elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
045   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null or empty
046   * @deprecated Use {@link #XmlFilterCommand(XPath)} instead
047   */
048  @Deprecated
049  public XmlFilterCommand(String xpath) {
050    if (xpath == null || xpath.trim().isEmpty()) {
051      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be null or empty");
052    }
053    this.legacyXpath = xpath.trim();
054    this.xpath = new XPath(xpath.trim());
055  }
056
057  /**
058   * Constructor for XML filtering with typed XPath selector.
059   *
060   * @param xpath the typed XPath to extract elements
061   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if xpath is null
062   */
063  public XmlFilterCommand(XPath xpath) {
064    if (xpath == null) {
065      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be null");
066    }
067    this.xpath = xpath;
068    this.legacyXpath = xpath.getPath();
069  }
070
071  @Override
072  protected String getCommandDetails() {
073    return String.format("XmlFilterCommand(xpath='%s')", xpath.getPath());
074  }
075
076  @Override
077  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
078      throws IOException {
079    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
080
081      XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
082      inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES, false);
083      inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD, false);
084
085      List<String> extractedElements = new ArrayList<>();
086
087      XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
088      List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
089      boolean isCapturing = false;
090      int captureDepth = 0;
091      int currentDepth = 0;
092
093      XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
094      StringWriter elementWriter = new StringWriter();
095
096      while (reader.hasNext()) {
097        XMLEvent event = reader.nextEvent();
098
099        if (event.isStartElement()) {
100          currentDepth++;
101          String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
102          currentPath.add(elementName);
103
104          // Check if this element matches our target path
105          if (xpath.matches(currentPath) && !isCapturing) {
106            isCapturing = true;
107            captureDepth = currentDepth;
108            elementWriter = new StringWriter();
109
110            try {
111              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
112              eventWriter.add(event);
113              eventWriter.close();
114            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
115              LOGGER.warning("Error writing start element: " + e.getMessage());
116            }
117          } else if (isCapturing && currentDepth > captureDepth) {
118            // We're inside a matching element, continue capturing
119            try {
120              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
121              eventWriter.add(event);
122              eventWriter.close();
123            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
124              LOGGER.warning("Error writing nested start element: " + e.getMessage());
125            }
126          }
127
128        } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
129          if (isCapturing) {
130            try {
131              XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
132              eventWriter.add(event);
133              eventWriter.close();
134            } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
135              LOGGER.warning("Error writing end element: " + e.getMessage());
136            }
137
138            // If we're closing the captured element
139            if (currentDepth == captureDepth) {
140              extractedElements.add(elementWriter.toString());
141              isCapturing = false;
142              captureDepth = 0;
143            }
144          }
145
146          currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
147          currentDepth--;
148
149        } else if (isCapturing) {
150          // Characters, comments, etc. inside captured element
151          try {
152            XMLEventWriter eventWriter = outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(elementWriter);
153            eventWriter.add(event);
154            eventWriter.close();
155          } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
156            LOGGER.warning("Error writing content: " + e.getMessage());
157          }
158        }
159      }
160
161      // Write extracted elements to output
162      writeExtractedElements(writer, extractedElements);
163
164      reader.close();
165    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
166      throw new IOException("Error processing XML: " + e.getMessage(), e);
167    }
168  }
169
170  /**
171   * Write extracted XML elements to the output writer
172   *
173   * @param writer the output writer
174   * @param elements list of extracted XML elements
175   * @throws IOException if writing fails
176   */
177  private void writeExtractedElements(Writer writer, List<String> elements) throws IOException {
178    if (elements.isEmpty()) {
179      // No matching elements found - output empty XML fragment
180      writer.write("");
181      writer.flush();
182      return;
183    }
184
185    if (elements.size() == 1) {
186      // Single element - write directly
187      writer.write(elements.get(0));
188    } else {
189      // Multiple elements - wrap in a root element
190      writer.write("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>");
191      writer.write("<filtered-results>");
192      for (String element : elements) {
193        writer.write(element);
194      }
195      writer.write("</filtered-results>");
196    }
197
198    writer.flush();
199  }
200}
